text:
jonah: heads-up — saw TLS handshake failures on Android 13 emulator (x86_64) when running kotlin sample with keepalive/ping enabled. physical devices fine. :thinking:

jonah: log: `javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException: Connection closed by peer` followed by OkHttp `route failed` and `connection shutdown`. Happens intermittently under load.

katie: interesting. do you have nginx/nginx-proxy in front? emulator networking + IPv6 dualstack sometimes flips paths.

jonah: proxy is haproxy (env test), and server announces IPv6. Emulator prefers IPv6 when available. Disabling HTTP/2 keepalive ping reduced failures.

sanjay: hmm — keepalive pings on HTTP/2 can interact poorly with emulator NAT. Try turning off keepalive or setting pingInterval to 0: `OkHttpClient.Builder().pingInterval(0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)` or `protocols(listOf(Protocol.HTTP_1_1))` for repro.

marta: if that's the fix we should add an onboarding note: "Android emulator + IPv6 + http2 pings can cause TLS resets; use adb reverse or disable pings for emulator runs."

jonah: quick repro: set `pingInterval(Duration.ofSeconds(15))` in client and spin up emulator + haproxy with v6 balance — reproduced ~30% of runs. Setting pingInterval(0) dropped to ~2%.

katie: can you paste small snippet?

jonah: ```kotlin
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .pingInterval(Duration.ofMillis(0)) // disable HTTP/2 ping on emulator
  .build()
```

sanjay: for SDK-level guidance, maybe detect running on emulator (android.os.Build.FINGERPRINT.contains("generic")) and set safer defaults in samples (disable http2 pings) — but avoid altering customer defaults. Document only.

marta: agree. we'll add a FAQ: "TLS handshake errors on Android emulator with HTTP/2 pings" listing workarounds: adb reverse, disable ping, force HTTP/1.1, or run on device. Also add a tiny sample in samples/android/networking that toggles pingInterval under an emulator flag.

ciara-bot: created sample job for emulator network tests (api33) — queued.

jonah: filed samples branch `jonah/emulator-http2-ping-fix` with snippet & test. I'll follow up with PR to docs.

katie: thanks — will watch CI flakes and add doc entry. :thumbsup:
